biotools.summary: WheatCNVb is a database and platform for exploring and comparing Copy Number Variation block (CNVb) profiles in hexaploid wheat. It allows users to query markers, visualize fingerprints, upload their own data for comparison, and facilitates digitalized germplasm management.
